mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Above-trend growth in GDPC1 (GDP) signals strong economic momentum, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as market anticipates sustained expansion.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds its 12-month moving average by 2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 exceeds the threshold in a moving average context.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO (supply) above 105.0 (2017=100 baseline) indicates robust production capacity, prompting central banks to maintain low rates and supporting equity valuations, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns not observed when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 in a sustained manner.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in PAYEMS (employment) above 6.5 million for three consecutive months signals labor market strength, reducing recession risks and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive when PAYEMS meets the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 above their 5-week moving averages signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-month window when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 4.0% combined with rising FEDFUNDS signals labor market strength and controlled inflation, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns not observed when UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.3% in 60-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, above-trend GDPC1 growth amplifies S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as market anticipates peak growth and reduced risk.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 4% growth from prior quarter
failure_condition: GDPC1 exceeds 4% growth but returns remain negative, or late-cycle regime not confirmed by other indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS above their 5-week moving averages signals inflationary pressure and tightening, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns unless accompanied by strong GDP growth.
failure_condition: Positive returns observed despite CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rising above thresholds in 20-day windows.
